sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case involves a prisoner seeking release from state custody. The state argued the petition arrived too late. The lower court dismissed the petition without the state formally raising the deadline issue. The prisoner argues the state gave up this defense by not raising it earlier.

paragraphs: This case defines the power of federal judges to enforce filing deadlines. It affects how states defend against late petitions. It shapes the balance between finality and access to courts.
